$comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: Community-Spec-1.0. FPSOT registry event data (REG-102). The data holds identifiers, codes and instants only, never a party id, a name, an address, the value of an identifier of an asset or of an entitlement, or an amount (REG-103). The CloudEvents attributes follow API-101.
title: org.fpsot.registry.filing.recorded
description: A register reached a final processing status for a filing and sealed it (REG-022, REG-031, REG-102).

filingType.description: The filing type, from the catalog of the pack (REG-021).

category.description: The category of the filing type (REG-021).

sequence.description: The number of the filing in its register (REG-030).

deadlineStatus.description: Whether the filing met its deadline (REG-033).

submittedAt.description: When the register received the filing (REG-023).

effectiveAt.description: When the legal act takes effect (REG-023).

completedAt.description: When the filing reached its final status (REG-023).

correctsFilingId.description: The filing that a correction replaces (REG-027).

destroyedFilingIds.description: The filings that a destruction filing destroyed (REG-093).
